mechanism: Sodium valproate inhibits UDP-glucuronosyltransferase (UGT) enzymes, reducing zidovudine glucuronidation and clearance, leading to increased zidovudine plasma concentrations and potential toxicity.
action: Monitor zidovudine concentrations and clinical toxicity closely; consider zidovudine dose reduction if used concomitantly; evaluate alternative antiretroviral agents if possible.
